title: Auto Everything | Best Script
features:
[ FARM ]

[+] Auto Farm Wins - checkpoint -> return button loop, ~48 payouts/min

[+] Farm World - Auto / World 1-5

[+] Stage - 1-9, higher stages pay far more

[+] Use VIP Double Wins - x2 button (needs the x2 Wins pass)

[+] Checkpoint Dwell - 1.00s default, self-tunes on misses

[+] Auto Farm Steps - parks you on the best usable treadmill

[+] Treadmill Select - Auto or a specific belt

[+] Auto Run In Place - holds the run input on the spot

[+] Rush Quantum Event - free x10 belt, beats the paid Diamond x9

[+] Skip Robux-Locked Belts - routes around any belt the server gates

[+] Freeze Position - anchors you, ignored during the wins farm

[+] Live status readout - wins, level, walk speed, cycle time

[ PROGRESS ]

[+] Auto Rebirth - fires the moment you hit the required level

[+] Hold Until Level - delay rebirth past the minimum

[+] Rebirth Now - manual, reports the level needed if refused

[+] Auto Best World - moves to the highest world your rebirths unlock

[+] Teleport To World 1-5 - five direct buttons

[+] Account readout - world, rebirths, level, next rebirth level, wins

[ SHOP ]

[+] Auto Buy Upgrades - unlocks + selects the strongest speed upgrade

[+] Equip Best Upgrade Now - manual

[+] Auto Buy Trail - most expensive trail you can afford

[+] Auto Equip Best Trail - highest multiplier owned

[+] Auto Buy Aura - most expensive aura you can afford

[+] Auto Equip Best Aura - highest multiplier owned

[+] Auto Buy Charm - any unbought charm in your world's shop

[+] Charm Price Cap - skip charms over a set price

[+] Auto Equip Best Charms - fills all 3 charm slots

[ COLLECT ]

[+] Auto Collect Bananas

[+] Auto Collect Tacos

[+] Auto Collect Lucky Blocks

[+] Auto Collect Hacker Portals

[+] Collect Radius - limit range, or 0 for map-wide

[+] Collect All 9 Shards - unlocks the free Sunken x2 treadmill

[+] Collect Shards Now - manual, with x/9 progress

[ REWARDS ]

[+] Auto Free Reward

[+] Auto Offline Earnings

[+] Auto Streak Rewards - claims every unclaimed day

[+] Auto Use Speed Potions - drinks when none is active

[+] Auto Use Wins Potions

[+] Auto Open Skull Chests - opens + spins pending chests

[+] Auto Enter Secret Door - requests entry while the event is up

[+] Auto Update Codes - rechecks every 30s, redeems new ones instantly

[+] Redeem All Codes - manual, shows the real server reason on reject

[ RACE ]

[+] Auto Join Race - joins every race the server opens

[+] Auto Win Race - moves you to the finish once it starts

[+] Join Race Now - manual

[ PLAYER ]

[+] Walk Speed - 0-500, 0 leaves the game in charge

[+] Noclip

[+] Infinite Jump

[+] Ignore Hazards - kills crusher / axe / press / car / lava hitboxes

[+] Teleport To Best Treadmill

[+] Teleport To Stage Checkpoint

[+] Teleport To Return Button

[ PROTECTION ]

[+] God Mode - keeps you upright and topped up

[+] Anti AFK

[+] Rejoin On Kick

[+] Panic Key - RightControl, kills every automation

[+] Panic Stop Now - button version

[ INFO ]

[+] Credits + Discord invite

[+] How the wins farm works

[+] Which treadmills are free

[+] Session stats - wins, runs, levels, rebirths, upgrades,

purchases, collected, shards, races, rewards,

errors, uptime

[+] Unload VoidHub
